newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BRUSSELS BOURSE SEEN RALLYING ON HOLDINGS SHAKE UP.
newsitem.headline: BRUSSELS BOURSE SEEN RALLYING ON HOLDINGS SHAKE UP.

text.p: 0715 GMT - Brussels bourse seen shrugging off bond market disappointment at French elections (first round) result and lower dollar to head higher on back of reshuffle in country's financial holding companies, which seen benefiting all holdings.
* On Friday it was announced Gevaert assets would effectively be divided between Cobepa and Almanij groups in complex operation over next three months.
* In pre-opening trade, Almanij up 3.7 pct at 16,000;
* Insurer Royale Belge also higher on speculation about future ahead annual general meeting on May 28.
* Bel-20 ended Friday at new closing high of 2,267.78 points
